description: Update one section of a capsule, or append an entry to its Session log. Other sections are preserved untouched. Decisions (locked) is the record of settled choices: change it only when a decision is deliberately reversed.

section.description: Which section to write. "Session log" appends; the others replace that section.

text.description: The new section content, or the log entry to append for "Session log".

token.description: Your per-agent token, on a token-enforced bus.

name: workspace_update_capsule
